note: Four briefs. This is the writing capability, so every failure here is one that reads well — a section is judged by a reviewer holding the sources, and the ways it goes wrong (a citation that resolves to nothing, an estimate that reads as a measurement, a number corrected in one place, a reviewer reply left standing in the discussion) all survive a proofread. Each brief names a real study or a real journal-shaped ask, because a toy string cannot fail the way a manuscript fails.

briefs.title: 回顾性队列的资料与方法：从数据字典到可复现的一节
briefs.why: The ordinary case, and the one that establishes what a clean section looks like so the other three have something to fail against. A methods section is the only one a reader is entitled to reproduce from the text alone, and the failure is quiet: a definition the run knows from the data dictionary and never writes down, or a result that drifts forward out of 结果 into 资料与方法 because it justifies a choice.

inputs.sources: 本院数据仓库导出的队列定义、数据字典与统计分析计划（二甲双胍用于合并 CKD 3 期的 2 型糖尿病患者，2019-01 至 2024-12，n=4,812），以及已确定的协变量清单

mustDo: 写清设计、时间窗、来源人群、纳入与排除、暴露与结局的操作性定义、随访起止与删失规则。
统计方法写到可复算：模型、协变量、缺失值处理、敏感性分析各自的用途。
在 delivery-summary.md 里点名 STROBE，并说明本节负责其中哪几条。
数据字典里没有定义的变量，写成缺口并说明需要什么才能补上。
mustNotDo: 把任何一个结果数字写进资料与方法（样本量与随访时长以外）。
用「采用标准方法进行统计分析」这类无法复现的句子代替方法。
为了让某个选择显得合理而先说出它的结论。
把检索、工具调用或文件路径写进正文。
briefs.gradedOn: Whether a statistician holding only this section and the data could rebuild the analysis, and whether every STROBE item the section owns is answered rather than named.

briefs.title: 用上一轮的证据包写讨论：来源是定的，论证不是
briefs.why: The data-flow this capability exists for: an evidence run finished, and its package — matrix, ledger, quotes — is the source set. The temptation is to reach for one more citation to make a paragraph land, and a source that was never in the package has no quote, no ledger row and no way for the reviewer to find it. The second temptation is the opposite: to restate 结果 paragraph by paragraph and call it a discussion.

inputs.sources: 上一轮 clinical-evidence-synthesis 交付的证据包（clinical-evidence-matrix.json + citation-ledger.csv + references.bib），主题为 SGLT2 抑制剂在慢性肾脏病中的肾脏结局，含 DAPA-CKD 与 EMPA-KIDNEY 的提取结果
inputs.manuscriptContext: 本研究为单中心真实世界队列，结果一节已定稿：主要结局的调整 HR 0.83（95% CI 0.71–0.97）

mustDo: 把本研究的发现放在 DAPA-CKD 与 EMPA-KIDNEY 之下讨论一致与不一致之处，并给出可能的机制或人群差异解释。
每一条跨来源的结论标为 synthesized，至少两条来源、各带原文引用，并给出置信度。
证据包里没有覆盖的问题写成缺口：需要什么设计、什么人群、什么终点才能回答。
每个 [n] 都能在 citation-ledger.csv 里找到对应行。
mustNotDo: 引用证据包之外的任何一条文献。
把结果一节逐段重述一遍。
把「未检索到支持性研究」写成「无效」或「不推荐」。
在讨论里出现结果一节没有的新数字。
briefs.gradedOn: Whether every citation in the section resolves to a row the prior run preserved, and whether the discussion argues rather than repeats.

briefs.title: 统计师改了主效应值：一次清点，不是一次替换
briefs.why: The failure this capability is most able to cause, and the one a reviewer catches and an author never does. The primary estimate changes after the draft exists, and it does not appear once — it is in 摘要, in 结果, in a table cell, in a 讨论 sentence comparing it with the trials, in a figure caption, and it has dependents: an NNT derived from it, a 「风险下降约两成」 in the abstract, an ordering across subgroups. Replacing the number where you remember seeing it leaves the rest standing and internally contradictory.

inputs.sources: 同 ms-002 的证据包，加上统计师的更正说明
inputs.existingDraft: 已定稿的讨论一节，其中主要结局写作调整 HR 0.78（95% CI 0.66–0.92），并据此写了 NNT 与「风险下降约两成」
inputs.manuscriptContext: 更正后的主要结局为调整 HR 0.83（95% CI 0.71–0.97）；亚组顺序因此改变

mustDo: 在改动前先把 0.78 出现过的每一处和每一条从它推出来的结论列出来。
重新推导 NNT，而不是按比例调整它；把它标为 derived，写清 derivedFrom、method、assumptions、sensitivity。
NNT 在正文中出现的每一处都带〔推导〕。
更新 section-claims.json 与 citation-ledger.csv，使其与正文一致。
在 revision-notes.md 里记下这次清点：改了哪个数、从多少到多少、波及了哪几处。
mustNotDo: 只替换掉记得的那几处。
把 NNT 或「风险下降约两成」按旧值等比例改写而不重新推导。
把推导结果当成测量值陈述（无〔推导〕标记）。
把亚组排序沿用旧值下的顺序。
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the old estimate survives anywhere in the deliverable, whether every dependent claim was re-derived rather than adjusted, and whether the sweep is recorded where the next person can read it.

briefs.title: 返修稿：回复审稿人，但不在正文里回复
briefs.why: Channel separation, in the situation that creates it. A revision produces three kinds of prose at once — the changed section, the reply to each comment, and the record of what changed — and under deadline all three end up in the same file. 「根据审稿人意见，我们已补充……」 in a discussion is the commonest backstage sentence in the literature, and it is invisible to the author because it is true.

inputs.manuscriptContext: 审稿意见三条：(1) 未讨论适应证混杂；(2) 与 EMPA-KIDNEY 人群差异未说明；(3) 结论强于证据

mustDo: 把三条意见都在讨论里实质回应：适应证混杂写进讨论与局限性，人群差异写清方向，结论下调到证据支持的强度。
逐条回复写进 revision-notes.md，附上改动位置。
在 revision-notes.md 里说明每一处改动为什么这么改。
用 edit 就地修改，保留未被意见触及的段落。
mustNotDo: 在正文里出现「根据审稿人意见」「本次修改」「本节旨在回应」之类关于这份稿子本身的句子。
把 revision-notes.md 的整段内容原样留在正文里。
整篇重写：未被意见触及的段落应当逐字不变。
在弱化结论的同时把限制条件也一并删掉。
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the discussion reads as a discussion rather than as a reply, whether all three comments are answered in substance, and whether the untouched paragraphs are byte-identical to the draft.
